QRY
QRY_DEN_DruidLair_BlockIfGoingOut((CHARACTER)_Player,(ITEM)_Door)
AND
DB_InRegion(_Player, S_DEN_LabToTunnelRoomBox_5de3e19e-26a3-4276-aa40-170c61e6842a)
AND
_Door == S_DEN_LibraryExitDoor_36922df6-960d-484b-bbcb-6ff6def13c2c
AND
IsOpened(S_DEN_LibraryEntryDoor_df1f2445-3737-4410-8f8c-b7af5967dea6, 0)
THEN
DB_NOOP(1);

IF
UseStarted(_, (ITEM)S_DEN_TunnelSideIn_0c63cc6f-e5d6-4561-a952-cf44e8ffac57)
AND
NOT DB_DEN_LibraryExitIsUnlocked(1)
THEN
PROC_DEN_DruidLair_RemoveRocks("Exit");

IF
AddedTo(_Object, _Helper, _)
AND
DB_LOW_StormshoreTabernacle_ExtraGods((CHARACTER)_Helper, _)
AND
GetStackAmount((ITEM)_object, _ExactItemAmount, _TotalAmount)
THEN
ToInventory((ITEM)_Object, S_LOW_GenericGodChest_8c43197d-6bfa-4ddf-9ee5-d3f75b1444d3, _ExactItemAmount, 0, 1);

IF
UseFinished(_Player, (ITEM)S_LOW_TeacherGrave_0c77cecb-f54f-4ec2-a8e7-8e594710c1b2, _)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
QRY_IsInRange(_Player, S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679, 8.0)
AND
QRY_OnlyOnce("LOW_Shadowheart_GraveSeen")
THEN
PROC_TryStartAD((DIALOGRESOURCE)LOW_Shadowheart_PAD_TeacherGrave_57c986b5-5954-5fe5-0531-934062f6da2c, S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679);
PROC_RelationshipDialog((CHARACTER)S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679, (DIALOGRESOURCE)ShadowHeart_InParty_95ca3833-09d0-5772-b16a-c7a5e9208fe5, (CHARACTER)S_Player_ShadowHeart_3ed74f06-3c60-42dc-83f6-f034cb47c679);
